# v2026.10.22

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.22.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/field/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.22.md).

This release covers **7 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- The account panel in Settings loads, and Profile no longer blanks the app. ([#182](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/182))
- The jobs list loads in 0.4 s instead of 1.6 s. ([#185](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/185))
- The site sends security headers and a report-only content security policy. ([#184](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/184))
- A problem report can ask for a reply. ([#176](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/176))

## Changes

- Problem reports can ask for a reply, tagged notify for the support task. ([#176](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/176))

## Fixes

- The account panel in Settings loads, and Profile no longer blanks the app. ([#182](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/182))
